query: INSERT INTO hosted_frontends(alias,tenant,channel,origin,experience_alias,app_id) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT(alias) DO UPDATE SET channel=excluded.channel,origin=excluded.origin,experience_alias=excluded.experience_alias,app_id=excluded.app_id,revision=hosted_frontends.revision+1 WHERE hosted_frontends.tenant=excluded.tenant RETURNING revision
